payload.text: Kofi is my older cousin, but our aunt raised us together, so he is a brother in every way that counts. When her illness got bad we started walking the levee path every Tuesday evening, and those walks held both of us together. I will mock his driving forever, and I turn protective the second anyone else is careless with him.
